provider: Hugging Face Datasets, uploaded by sylviaHoch
verification_method: Verified via the dataset's own peer-reviewed paper (arXiv 2608.01963v1, 'OSSDD - a New Open Dataset for Sentinel-1 Ship Detection'), whose data-availability statement names this exact Hugging Face repo as the official host. The repo itself was then fetched directly and confirmed to exist with matching file structure. Not a filename-only guess and not an unverified mirror.
dataset_version: as published, last modified 2026-08-04 per Hugging Face metadata at verification time
expected_format: 32-bit float TIFF chips (Chip_VV/, Chip_VH/), AABB annotations (Metadata_aabb/), RBB annotations (Metadata_rbb/), binary 8-bit GeoTIFF masks (Rotated_Masks/), metadata.csv defining train/val/test splits; also offered pre-packaged as ossdd.zip and as WebDataset .tar shards (90 train + 8 val + 16 test)
expected_size_human: 72.3 GB (as stated on the dataset page)
geographic_extent: Global (Sentinel-1 GRD scenes; not region-restricted to VARUNA's current study areas)
temporal_extent: Unconfirmed per-scene; not verified this pass since the dataset was not downloaded

scale.note: matches this project's brief's stated ~15k patches / ~55k ships exactly

sensor_product: Sentinel-1 GRD (Ground Range Detected) — the correct product level, unlike this project's local ASF archive (Level-0 RAW)
license: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 for annotations/code; underlying Sentinel-1 imagery remains subject to Copernicus Sentinel Data Terms and Conditions
license_caveat: NonCommercial clause (NC) — must be checked against VARUNA's eventual usage/distribution terms before any commercial deployment path, not just before a research/training use
reason_required: Only candidate CHHAYA training dataset with a genuinely verified, unambiguous official source and exact-matching scale (15,197 patches / 55,759 ships) to this project's stated OSSD requirement. Confirmed absent from all local storage (D:\ROUTER(DATASETS)\ recursive search, no ossd/OpenSARShip directory or file found anywhere).
acquisition_decision_reason: 72.3GB download deferred: (1) CHHAYA's current architecture per docs/adr/CHHAYA-ARCHITECTURE-DECISION.md (option C, AIS-coverage-gap heuristic) does not require any training dataset today; (2) a sustained 72GB network+disk write while NETRA's training process is actively reading the same physical disk is exactly the kind of large concurrent HDD workload the project's disk-safety policy asks to avoid unless absolutely necessary; (3) D: has ample free space (>1TB at last catalog build) so this is a scheduling decision, not a capacity one. See docs/datasets/OSSDD_CHHAYA_COMPATIBILITY.md for the full compatibility analysis and science-lead decision point.
download_method_if_authorized: huggingface_hub.hf_hub_download(repo_id='sylviaHoch/OpenSARShip-Ship-Detection-Dataset', filename='ossdd.zip', repo_type='dataset') for the single-archive form, or streaming the WebDataset .tar shards for a partial/incremental acquisition that avoids holding the full 72GB at once
planned_storage_path_if_authorized: D:\ROUTER(DATASETS)\_downloads\ossdd\ (raw download) -> D:\ROUTER(DATASETS)\ossdd\ (extraction, new isolated location, collision-checked before extraction, never overwriting)
